MultipathResilienceMode.description: The MultipathResilience mode. Only valid when AllowMultipathResilience is true.

AllowMultipathResilience.description: Whether to enable MultipathResilience on this side of the peering attachment.

Value.description: The value of the tag. Constraints: Tag values are case-sensitive and accept a maximum of 255 Unicode characters.

Key.description: The key of the tag. Constraints: Tag keys are case-sensitive and accept a maximum of 127 Unicode characters. May not begin with aws:.

Status.description: The status of the transit gateway peering attachment.

Options.description: Options for transit gateway peering attachment

PeerAccountId.description: The ID of the peer account

TransitGatewayId.description: The ID of the transit gateway.

PeerTransitGatewayId.description: The ID of the peer transit gateway.

AccepterAllowMultipathResilience.description: Whether the accepter side of the peering attachment has opted in to MultipathResilience.

RequesterMultipathResilienceMode.description: The MultipathResilience mode chosen by the requester side of the peering attachment.

State.description: The state of the transit gateway peering attachment. Note that the initiating state has been deprecated.

CreationTime.description: The time the transit gateway peering attachment was created.

RequesterAllowMultipathResilience.description: Whether the requester side of the peering attachment has opted in to MultipathResilience.

Tags.description: The tags for the transit gateway peering attachment.

TransitGatewayAttachmentId.description: The ID of the transit gateway peering attachment.

MultipathResilienceStatus.description: The connection-level MultipathResilience status, computed from both sides of the peering attachment. (enabled/pending/disabled)
